scope: Two development documents, replica0 only, 48 layers x 2 TP ranks x 2 KV heads each; no independent-document inference from layers/heads/replicas.

definitions.counts: n_o is the number of selected shared-document tokens whose original owner bitmask is o, o in 1..7.
definitions.compact_exact: C=sum_o r(o)*n_o, units M16-times-token; all D/K dimensions are common and omitted.
definitions.fixed_exact: F(P)=sum_{g in P} r(g)*sum_{o:o&g!=0} n_o; packed union may cross owner boundaries inside each fixed group.
definitions.compact_N64: C64=sum_o r(o)*ceil(n_o/64); one tail per nonempty owner region, no extra split tails.
definitions.fixed_N64: F64(P)=sum_{g in P} r(g)*ceil(sum_{o:o&g!=0} n_o/64); one tail per fixed group, no extra split tails.
definitions.best_fixed: For each rank/layer/head, independently minimize over all five B3 partitions, separately for exact and N64 counts; a hindsight logical-work oracle, not a measured latency winner or deployed chooser.
definitions.aggregation: Sum each work count over the 192 cohorts, then take ratio of sums; do not average per-cohort ratios.
definitions.logical_KV: Independent=sum_o popcount(o)*n_o; union=sum_o n_o. These count logical requests to payload, not GDDR transactions.

limitations: Logical MMA ratios are not complete runtime upper bounds; bandwidth, scheduling, occupancy, instructions, barriers and cache behavior can differ.
System prefix, protected private document tail, question suffix and generated tail are omitted; no prepare, planning, final merge, copy or selector cost is included.
The omitted private work and uncharged owner transitions favor an optimistic dynamic accounting; no split-boundary overhead is modeled.
M16 arithmetic counts are not the instruction count of native SIMT/XQA or a proof of its roofline bottleneck.
Fixed partition is allowed to coalesce its union across owner boundaries, as the strong existing control does.

The arithmetic-only Amdahl values assume equal time per logical work unit, all attention time proportional to arithmetic, and zero added cost; they are conditional illustrations, not measured model improvements or universal bounds.
Logical 2.6x KV sharing cannot establish GDDR savings; native E0 can reuse shared addresses in L2 and GPU counters are unavailable without additional permissions.
No GQA16/32 shape expansion, new kernel, GPU run, mask change, quality test or novelty claim is proposed.

provenance.decode_step_definition: s1 is each actual suffix-prefill query predicting first generated token (selector compatibility only); s16/s64/s256 are same-forward ready-group snapshots anchored on question0 prediction step, with each request's own actual position retained
provenance.mask_definition: Budget applies to the full original document; protected partial-page document tail resides in private suffix and is omitted from common-source masks only. All original selected tokens remain in execution.

existing_measured_example.scope: Existing corrected-suffix L15/step64 original-document rank0 operator measurement, not the hypothetical register-bank implementation and not all-48 production latency.

resource_scope: Saved shape-specific cubin receipts; no spill/DRAM/bank-conflict attribution or new compiler measurement.
decision: One unimplemented register-layout gap is technically plausible, but current GQA8 logical arithmetic headroom and unproven memory advantage do not justify restarting the stopped dynamic direction. No candidate recommended.
